source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The dialog uses the shared event ID plus a recurrence-id nativeTime value to select a specific occurrence. The historical patch set the attribute for occurrences but did not clear it for parent events. The fixed setter explicitly removes recurrence-id when the new event has none. Its inspected test distinguishes the parent title from an exception title. Preserve those separate identities and the current reset behavior; no recurring-event or provider race ran.
title: Calendar occurrence identity must be cleared when switching back to a parent event
